name: TabletQuestionBank
css: .tablet-question-bank-page{min-height:100vh;background:#f5f7fa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei','Noto Sans SC',sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.top-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:64px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f5;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100}.nav-left{display:flex;align-items:center}.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.logo-text{font-size:20px;font-weight:800;color:#1A365D}.nav-center{flex:1;max-width:400px;margin:0 24px}.search-box{display:flex;align-items:center;background:#f5f7fa;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:8px;padding:0 12px}.search-box input{flex:1;border:none;background:transparent;padding:10px 8px;font-size:14px;color:#1a2b5f;outline:none}.nav-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.nav-icon{cursor:pointer}.user-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1A365D 0%,#2a5298 100%);border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer}.main-content{flex:1;display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr 300px;gap:20px;padding:20px;overflow:hidden}.left-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.action-card,.category-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.action-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.action-item:hover{background:#f8f9fc}.action-info{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.action-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f}.action-desc{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.card-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:16px}.card-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0}.card-action{font-size:12px;color:#1890ff;cursor:pointer}.category-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.category-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer;color:#5a6488}.category-item:hover{background:#f8f9fc;color:#1A365D}.category-item.active{background:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.category-name{flex:1;font-size:14px;font-weight:500}.category-count{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.center-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.filter-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.filter-tabs{display:flex;gap:12px}.filter-tab{padding:6px 16px;border-radius:6px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer}.filter-tab.active{background:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.filter-actions{display:flex;gap:12px}.question-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}.question-grid.list-view{grid-template-columns:1fr}.question-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04);cursor:pointer}.question-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(26,54,95,0.1);transform:translateY(-2px)}.question-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.question-type{padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600}.question-difficulty{display:flex;gap:2px}.question-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#1a2b5f;margin:0 0 12px}.question-meta{display:flex;gap:16px;margin-bottom:12px}.meta-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.question-tags{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tag{padding:4px 10px;background:#f5f7fa;border-radius:4px;font-size:11px;color:#5a6488}.pagination{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.page-info{font-size:13px;color:#8899aa}.page-buttons{display:flex;gap:8px}.page-btn{padding:6px 12px;border:1px solid #e8ecf1;border-radius:6px;background:#ffffff;font-size:13px;color:#5a6488;cursor:pointer}.page-btn.active{background:#1A365D;border-color:#1A365D;color:#ffffff}.right-panel{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;overflow-y:auto}.stats-card,.recent-card{background:#ffffff;border-radius:12px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,54,95,0.04)}.stats-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}.stat-item{text-align:center;padding:12px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:8px}.stat-value{display:block;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#1A365D;margin-bottom:4px}.stat-label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.recent-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}.recent-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px;background:#f8f9fc;border-radius:8px;cursor:pointer}.recent-item:hover{background:#f0f2f5}.recent-info{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.recent-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;color:#1a2b5f}.recent-desc{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}.bottom-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:40px;padding:0 24px;background:#ffffff;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f5}.bar-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}.online-status,.sync-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:#5a6488}.version{font-size:12px;color:#8899aa}@media(max-width:1024px){.main-content{grid-template-columns:1fr}.left-panel,.right-panel{display:none}}
